components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional. When present it must be valid for the owner's city per the fixed region ranges (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit value. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when omitted. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Request-only flag. When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner has the same lastName and address (i.e. they share a household), and assigns both owners the same householdId. Not stored or returned (see the read-only householdId for the resulting shared identifier).
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where REGION is the region code derived from the postcode (or 'UNKNOWN' when it resolves to no known region) and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over (normalizedTelephone + lastName).
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              readOnly: true
              example: 7
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, assigned on create. Starts at 1, plus 1 when an email is present, plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0, capped at 3. Level 4 is reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              readOnly: true
              example: 3
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region taken from the REGION prefix of the customerCode, i.e. the region derived from the postcode range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), or 'UNKNOWN' when the postcode resolves to no known range.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW'
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable shared identifier for the owner's household. Owners at the same address with the same lastName that opt in via sharesHousehold share one householdId.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '3f2504e0-4f89-41d3-9a0c-0305e82c3301'
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The owner's derived duplicate-detection identity, formed as normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + householdId. A create is rejected with 409 only when a new owner's whole identityKey equals an existing owner's; the former separate telephone, email and household duplicate checks are all expressed through this one key.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61400000001||'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was created, shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively). Zero when the name was unique on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 other owners share this owner's effective (business-day) registration date, i.e. more than 80 owners were already created that day; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, derived as 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              readOnly: true
              example: 'EMAIL'
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional. When present it must be valid for the owner's city per the fixed region ranges (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit value. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when omitted. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. Optional. When present, it drives the derived ageBand (computed against the registrationDate). Accepted and returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Request-only flag. When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner has the same lastName and address (i.e. they share a household), and assigns both owners the same householdId. Not stored or returned (see the read-only householdId for the resulting shared identifier).
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where REGION is the region code derived from the postcode (or 'UNKNOWN' when it resolves to no known region) and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over (normalizedTelephone + lastName).
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              readOnly: true
              example: 7
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, assigned on create. Starts at 1, plus 1 when an email is present, plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0, capped at 3. Level 4 is reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              readOnly: true
              example: 3
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region taken from the REGION prefix of the customerCode, i.e. the region derived from the postcode range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), or 'UNKNOWN' when the postcode resolves to no known range.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW'
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable shared identifier for the owner's household. Owners at the same address with the same lastName that opt in via sharesHousehold share one householdId.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '3f2504e0-4f89-41d3-9a0c-0305e82c3301'
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The owner's derived duplicate-detection identity, formed as normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + householdId. A create is rejected with 409 only when a new owner's whole identityKey equals an existing owner's; the former separate telephone, email and household duplicate checks are all expressed through this one key.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61400000001||'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was created, shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively). Zero when the name was unique on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 other owners share this owner's effective (business-day) registration date, i.e. more than 80 owners were already created that day; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, derived as 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              readOnly: true
              example: 'EMAIL'
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

Implemented the `birthDate` → `ageBand` derivation for `POST /api/owners` (read back via `GET /api/owners/{id}`).

**Changes:**

1. **`openapi.yml`** — the source for the generated DTOs:
   - Added optional `birthDate` (`string`/`format: date`) to the `OwnerFields` schema (request + stored/returned field).
   - Added read-only `ageBand` enum (`MINOR`/`ADULT`/`SENIOR`) to the `Owner` schema's read-only block.

2. **`Owner.java`** entity — added a `birthDate` `LocalDate` field mapped to a new `birth_date` column, with getter/setter. MapStruct maps `birthDate` DTO↔entity automatically by name.

3. **`AgeBand.java`** (new, mapper package) — follows the `ContactPreference` precedent: returns `OwnerDto.AgeBandEnum`, computing whole years between `birthDate` and `registrationDate` via `Period.between`, banding as MINOR (<18), ADULT (18–64), SENIOR (65+); returns `null` when no `birthDate` so the field is omitted.

4. **`OwnerMapper.java`** — wired `@Mapping(target = "ageBand", expression = "java(AgeBand.of(owner))")`, so both the POST and GET responders (which call `toOwnerDto`) emit it.

5. **`schema.sql`** (hsqldb, h2, mysql, postgres) — added the `birth_date DATE` column to the `owners` table. Required because the test profile (`hsqldb`) runs with `ddl-auto=none` and relies on the explicit schema.

**Why against `registrationDate`:** `AgeBand.of` reads `owner.getRegistrationDate()`, which `BuildOwner` has already resolved to the effective (supplied-or-defaulted, business-day-adjusted) date — matching the spec. The test (`birthDate=1990-01-01`, registration defaults to today ~2026 → age ~36 → `ADULT`) passes, as does the full suite (`BUILD SUCCESS`, 1/1).

No git repository here, so nothing was committed.
